title: Tryptamines I Have Known And Loved — Complete Synthesis Library

compounds.name: DMT
compounds.description: Prototypical short-acting entheogenic tryptamine, widely present in botanical taxa (Mimosa hostilis, Psychotria viridis) and endogenously in mammalian tissue.

routes.name: Speeter-Anthony route from indole via indole-3-glyoxyl chloride and LAH reduction

workup.isolation: Filter bright yellow glyoxyl chloride, suspend in dry ether, add dimethylamine at 0 C
workup.filtration: Filter precipitated yellow crystals of N,N-dimethylindole-3-glyoxylamide
workup.washing: Wash thoroughly with cold water and ether

workup.quench: Fieser workup at 0 C (5.2 mL H2O, 5.2 mL 15% NaOH, 15.6 mL H2O)
workup.isolation: Filter aluminate cake, dry filtrate over anhydrous MgSO4, evaporate under reduced pressure

compounds.name: 5-MeO-DMT
compounds.description: High-potency 5-methoxy substituted tryptamine found naturally in the parotoid secretions of Incilius alvarius and species of Virola.

workup.quench: Direct addition of amine to glyoxyl chloride slurry at 0 C
workup.isolation: Filter crystalline amide, wash with cold water

workup.quench: Fieser quench

compounds.name: Psilocin
compounds.description: Active dephosphorylated metabolite of psilocybin occurring in Psilocybe mushrooms, rapidly oxidised to blue quinonoid pigments in air.

routes.name: Speeter-Anthony from 4-benzyloxyindole followed by catalytic debenzylation (Pd/C)

workup.quench: Fieser quench, isolate freebase 4-benzyloxy-DMT

workup.filtration: Filter catalyst over Celite under argon blanket to avoid pyrophoric ignition
workup.evaporation: Evaporate solvent under vacuum with oxygen exclusion

compounds.name: 4-AcO-DMT (Psilacetin)
compounds.description: Acetylated prodrug of psilocin synthesised by O-acetylation with acetic anhydride.

routes.name: Direct O-acetylation of psilocin freebase with acetic anhydride

workup.quench: Ice water pour, basify with aqueous sodium bicarbonate
workup.salt_formation: Add stoichiometric fumaric acid in acetone to precipitate crystalline fumarate

compounds.name: DPT
compounds.description: Dipropyl substituted tryptamine derivative, synthesized via indole glyoxylamide with dipropylamine and LAH reduction.

workup.isolation: Filter crystalline amide, wash with dilute HCl and water

workup.quench: Fieser quench
workup.salt_formation: Convert to HCl salt with ethereal HCl

compounds.name: 5-MeO-DiPT (Foxy)
compounds.description: Diisopropyl-substituted 5-methoxytryptamine derivative, noted for its auditory effects.

workup.isolation: Filter crystalline amide, wash with water and ether

workup.quench: Fieser quench

compounds.name: Psilocybin
compounds.description: Natural zwitterionic prodrug to psilocin found in Psilocybe mushrooms, prepared synthetically via regioselective phosphorylation of psilocin.

routes.name: Phosphorylation of psilocin with dibenzyl phosphorochloridate followed by hydrogenolysis

workup.quench: Aqueous sodium bicarbonate extraction, partition into chloroform

workup.isolation: Filter catalyst through Celite, concentrate under vacuum

compounds.name: 5-MeO-MiPT (Moxy)
compounds.description: Popular unsymmetrical dialkyltryptamine with potent tactile and empathogenic signature.

workup.isolation: Filter crystalline amide, wash with cold ether

workup.quench: Fieser quench
workup.salt_formation: Dry HCl gas into ethyl acetate

compounds.name: DiPT
compounds.description: Renowned for its unique pharmacological selective distortion of auditory pitch perception.

routes.name: Speeter-Anthony synthesis from indole and diisopropylamine

workup.quench: Fieser quench

compounds.name: DET
compounds.description: Short-acting dialkyltryptamine investigated clinically by Stephen Szara.

routes.name: Indole + oxalyl chloride + diethylamine followed by LAH reduction

workup.isolation: Filter crystalline amide, wash with water and ether

workup.quench: Fieser quench

compounds.name: aMT (alpha-MT)
compounds.description: Alpha-methylated tryptamine analogue, developed originally as an antidepressant (Indopan).

routes.name: Indole-3-carboxaldehyde Henry condensation with nitroethane and reduction

workup.quench: Crash in ice water, collect brilliant orange crystalline nitropropene
Fieser quench

compounds.name: Harmine
compounds.description: Archetypal reversible MAO-A inhibitor alkaloid from Banisteriopsis caapi and Peganum harmala, prepared via Pictet-Spengler condensation and dehydrogenation.

routes.name: 6-Methoxytryptamine Pictet-Spengler condensation with acetaldehyde followed by aromatization

workup.quench: Basify with aqueous ammonia to pH 9.5, extract with chloroform

workup.isolation: Filter hot catalyst, cool to crystallize brilliant prismatic needles

compounds.name: 4-HO-MET (Metocin)
compounds.description: Widely studied 4-hydroxy tryptamine with high potency and vivid visual effects.

routes.name: Speeter-Anthony synthesis via 4-benzyloxyindole and oxalyl chloride

workup.quench: Filter crystalline glyoxylamide, wash with cold ether, dry under vacuum
Filter catalyst over Celite, salt with fumaric acid in ethanol to give white crystals (mp 168 °C)

compounds.name: 4-HO-MiPT (Miprocin)
compounds.description: Orally active psilocin analogue with rapid action and distinct cognitive clarity.

routes.name: Reaction of 4-benzyloxyindole with oxalyl chloride and methylisopropylamine

workup.quench: Reduce glyoxylamide with LAH, deprotect O-benzyl with Pd/C and H2, precipitate fumarate (mp 173-174 °C)

compounds.name: Ibogaine
compounds.description: Complex monoterpene indole alkaloid from Tabernanthe iboga root bark. Intense addiction-interrupting neuropharmacology.

routes.name: Selective total alkaloid extraction and recrystallization from Tabernanthe iboga bark

workup.quench: Basify extract to pH 10.5 with NH4OH, extract with ethyl acetate, precipitate hydrochloride salt (mp 299 °C decomp)

compounds.name: 5-MeO-DALT
compounds.description: Diallylated 5-methoxytryptamine derivative synthesized by Alexander Shulgin in 2004.

routes.name: Reaction of 5-methoxyindole with oxalyl chloride and diallylamine followed by LAH reduction

workup.quench: Standard LAH quench, precipitate hydrochloride salt from anhydrous ether (mp 180-181 °C)

compounds.name: Melatonin
compounds.description: Endogenous circadian pineal hormone synthesized from serotonin via serotonin N-acetyltransferase and ASMT.

routes.name: Direct N-acetylation of 5-methoxytryptamine with acetic anhydride

workup.quench: Pour into ice water, collect crystalline plates, recrystallize from ethanol/water (mp 116-118 °C)
